model3_sensitivity.tires_note: Headline tire cost uses the budget tire's mileage warranty, the same method as the gas cars. A realistic ~30,000-mile wear figure is also shown, because Model 3 tires often wear faster than the warranty (Consumer Reports has reported many EV owners replacing tires at or before 30,000 miles).
model3_sensitivity.insurance_note: Headline insurance uses the same scaled minimum-plus-comprehensive method as the gas cars ($976/year for a Model 3). Insurance.com's California full-coverage average for a Model 3 is $4,532/year (May 2026, 100/300/100, $500 deductibles, 40-year-old driver). That is not a personal quote, but it is the right sensitivity if the policy is full coverage at typical Model 3 rates.
